review_evidence: README identifies this as a Lean formalization of partial combinatory algebras developed as a formalized-mathematics course model project.
The nine primary files contain 65 proposition declarations and 148 declaration-style items, including Kleene algebra computability, S/K combinator specifications and abstraction/evaluation lemmas.
The project is an independent mathematical and computability-theory formalization and remains retained.
summary: Reviewed partial-combinatory-algebras; its theorem-bearing PCA and Kleene-algebra formalization is retained.
